key.description: A collection key or a field key: `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$`. Keys appear in URLs, filters and record bodies; `label` is the text people read.

binding.description: `global`: records belong to the app and no robot. `per_robot`: every record belongs to one robot (system field `robot_id`, fixed when the record is created). `one_per_robot`: every robot of the app has exactly one record, which Fleetless creates itself.

read_roles.description: The roles that may read the records.

warnings.description: `no_role_access`: no role may read these records. `unknown_role`: `access` names a role the app does not have. `history_growing`: the history is far larger than the records, which often means a client writing in a loop.

revisions.description: Entries in the history of all the collection's records.

history_bytes.description: The size of that history in bytes.

updated_at.description: When a record of the collection last changed. Null if it never held one.

description: A collection as the developer's overview shows it.
